observed_summary.deadline: Fixed non-detaching one-child program triggered the 1-second deadline and reported its owned process group gone.
observed_summary.streams: Fixed one-child flood program triggered the stream limit, retained exactly 1024 bytes per stream, and reported its owned process group gone.
observed_summary.cleanup: Independent filesystem checks confirmed original inputs and outside canaries unchanged, no extra owned paths, and scratch directory absent.
observed_summary.policy: All three profiles deny default and network, with explicit runtime read whitelist and owned input/scratch permissions.

limitations: Coverage is restricted to the three source-bound fixed Perl programs under the observed macOS helper/profile hashes.
Owned process cleanup is established for the fixed cooperative leader and one non-detaching child; arbitrary detaching or adversarial descendants were not tested or admitted.

The driver independently checked filesystem postconditions and bindings. Process-group disappearance is the backend's real OS observation; the driver did not independently trace individual descendant PIDs.
Network-deny policy is present, but no network probe was authorized or performed.
No authentication, credentials, accounts, providers, general worker command, shared-workspace patch application or concurrent scheduler was exercised.
Runtime read exceptions include documented system runtime trees and exact root-directory metadata access; this is not zero-read isolation.
Unchanged legacy run denial remains mandatory; these observations do not authorize actual AGY execution.
next_step: Use this exact fixed-backend observation as a prerequisite for a separately bounded general-worker/auth compatibility design and baseline.
